content.prompt: Compare these quantities using ratio notation.

spec.description: Two blue triangles followed by three purple squares in one horizontal row.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied shapes are visible; no counts or answers are labelled.

answer.worked: There are 3 squares and 2 triangles, so squares : triangles is $3:2$.
There are 2 triangles and 3 squares, so triangles : squares is $2:3$.

There are $2+3=5$ shapes. The 3 squares give squares : shapes as $3:5$.

spec.description: Six individually countable carrots on the left, beside seven potatoes on the right in rows of four and three.
spec.answerVisibility: Vegetable illustrations only; no numerical answers or count labels.

answer.worked: There are 6 carrots and 7 potatoes, so carrots : potatoes is $6:7$.

There are $6+7=13$ vegetables. The 7 potatoes give potatoes : vegetables as $7:13$.
